-- name: Bloogy_Shellcracker
-- Generated by scripts/quests/velious-backlog.mjs; edit server/internal/quest/velious_backlog_quests.json.
-- P99: https://wiki.project1999.com/Saucy_Salted_Seadragon_Steak (sha256 443a84802740efe2c918a5eeaad8ccfe0c1be9e2043ee07fefe2539835c6b4dd)
-- Original: server/internal/quest/upstream/projecteq/cobaltscar/Bloogy_Shellcracker.pl (sha256 19115f29f32bc4b8898a3b35d36fdb433f0598872aee08aba602a18030849171)
-- P99-reviewed Velious content. Quest faction gates deliberately bypassed; actual faction rewards retained.
-- P99 requires either seadragon meat plus seaweed and TWO fish eggs together; independent partial Perl checks are not equivalent.
local item_lib = require("items")

function event_say(e)
  if e.message:findi("hail") then
    e.self:Say("Hello, strange one. I am Bloogy Shellcracker, the preparer of meals for my people. I am not familiar with the culinary tastes of your kind but you are welcome to purchase some of my supplies. I will also barter for ingredients to some of my exotic dishes.")
  elseif e.message:findi("ingredients") then
    e.self:Say("The rarest treat I can prepare for my people is saucy salted seadragon steak. I wish to barter for some water dragon or sea dragon meat, saltwater seaweed, and fish eggs. The rest of the ingredients are collected locally by our collectors.")
  end
end

function event_trade(e)
  if item_lib.check_turn_in(e.trade, { item1 = 22812, item2 = 19113, item3 = 16498, item4 = 16498 }) then
    e.self:Say("It has been many moons since my people have feasted on this rarest of meat. Take this totem crafted in the form of our oceanlord Prexus and inscribed with the runes of our people. May the oceans watch over you, " .. e.other:GetCleanName() .. ".")
    e.other:SummonItem(28514)
    e.other:AddEXP(15000)
    e.other:Faction(432, 30, 0)
    e.other:Faction(431, -60, 0)
  elseif item_lib.check_turn_in(e.trade, { item1 = 22813, item2 = 19113, item3 = 16498, item4 = 16498 }) then
    e.self:Say("It has been many moons since my people have feasted on this rarest of meat. Take this totem crafted in the form of our oceanlord Prexus and inscribed with the runes of our people. May the oceans watch over you, " .. e.other:GetCleanName() .. ".")
    e.other:SummonItem(28514)
    e.other:AddEXP(15000)
    e.other:Faction(432, 30, 0)
    e.other:Faction(431, -60, 0)
  end
  -- Return unrelated and surplus offers on both accepted and rejected trades.
  item_lib.return_items(e.self, e.other, e.trade)
end
